import json,collections
p='answers.jsonl'; items=[json.loads(l) for l in open('items.jsonl')]; answers=[json.loads(l) for l in open(p)]
for i,note in [(56,'Stroke length is near the en/em dash boundary.'),(65,'Dot height is less certain against the handwritten digits.')]:
 answers[i]['confidence']='low'; answers[i]['note']=note
open(p,'w').write(''.join(json.dumps(a)+'\n' for a in answers))
answers=[json.loads(l) for l in open(p)]
assert len(items)==len(answers)==85
for t,a in zip(items,answers):
 assert a['item_id']==t['item_id']
 assert a['answer'] in t['options']
 assert a['confidence'] in ('high','low')
 assert isinstance(a['note'],str)
assert len({a['item_id'] for a in answers})==len(items)
c=collections.Counter(t['options'][a['answer']] for t,a in zip(items,answers))
print('Validated count, order, unique IDs, option letters, and confidence values.')
print('Items:',len(answers))
for k in ['raised dot','baseline dot','comma','hyphen','en dash','em dash','space','nothing','other','unreadable']:print(k+':',c[k])
print('Low confidence:',sum(a['confidence']=='low' for a in answers))
